preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 2000.
For each test case, the length of the string n must be at least a and at most 2000.
The number of distinct letters b must be at least 1 and at most the minimum of 26 and a.
The total length of all strings across test cases must not exceed 2000.

postconditions.description: The output string s must have a length equal to n.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(s[i:i+a])) == b for i in range(n - a + 1))
postconditions.description: Each substring of length a in the output string must contain exactly b distinct letters.
